actual-capacity.purpose: Only to determine actual date-matched capacity beyond recorded allocations.

additional-risk.purpose: Specific additional required risk investigation, not automatic whole-portfolio expansion.

financial-detail.purpose: Resolve a financial definition, reconciliation, expense policy or SOW commercial requirement not covered by primary sources.

native-indicator.purpose: Interpret observed/requested native state and its historical/coverage semantics.

unanswered-obligation.purpose: Reconcile requested items not accounted for by the primary workflow.

visual-capability.purpose: Equivalent permitted output when source renderer is unsupported; no silent standard-layout override.

rule: Load only when the primary specification cannot resolve the actual requested requirement; never override answered source behavior.
